exposure: personal history (age, body mass index, polycystic ovary syndrome, oral contraceptive use, assisted reproduction)
inflammatory markers in blood cell analysis
fetal ultrasound indices (biparietal diameter, head circumference, femur length)
cohort: The study included 383 pregnant women, with 67 diagnosed with GDM and 316 with normal glucose tolerance.
finding: Age of pregnant woman ≥30 years old, BMI≥24.0 kg/m² in early pregnancy, history of adverse pregnancy, and history of oral contraceptive use were identified as independent risk factors for GDM.
